text:
carla: FYI - Prospect (StateLedger) asked for an on-prem air-gapped POC. Main asks: signed delivery artifacts, SBOM, HSM-compatible verification, formal chain-of-custody, and a defined upgrade cadence. Can we confirm constraints and pricing?

ethan: We can supply two artifact types: full bundle (operator + runtime + model snapshot) and delta minibundles (weights diff + manifest). Typical sizes: full ~25-60GB, delta ~0.5-6GB.

priya: Lead times: full bundle build + signed SBOM ~3bd, minibundle ~1bd. Physical courier adds ~2-4bd depending on region. If they want expedited pickup we can do same-day at extra cost.

carla: Telemetry - they demand zero outbound telemetry. Legal/SEC need explicit "no-beacon" language and supportability details.

legal: We can agree to no-beacon builds. Contract must state:
- telemetry disabled by default and verified in manifest
- log retention cap (e.g., 90 days) if requested
- on-site or offline diagnostics options listed as paid support
Also call out that remote debugging is not available without telemetry.

ethan: Verification checklist to send SecOps (compact):
- sha256sum bundle matches manifest
- verify signature: openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle.sig redwood-bundle.tar.gz
- validate SBOM (cyclonedx) matches artifact
- dry-run install in isolated staging (no egress)
- confirm telemetry flag disabled in config.yaml
- smoke test: run local request against /v1/generate and validate responses

priya: Sample commands we include in email:

sha256sum redwood-bundle-2026-11-05.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle-2026-11-05.sig redwood-bundle-2026-11-05.tar.gz
cyclonedx-cli verify --sbom redwood-bundle-2026-11-05-sbom.json --artifact redwood-bundle-2026-11-05.tar.gz
cat manifest.json | jq '.images[] | {name, digest}'

carla: Upgrade cadence question: they asked monthly security patches + optional monthly minibundles vs quarterly full model updates. What do we price?

ethan: Our standard: monthly small security deltas + quarterly fulls. For true monthly minibundles push we treat as custom: one-time packaging/signing fee + monthly retainer for patch generation, signing, and courier coordination. Add +15% support uplift for no-telemetry.

legal: Add emergency hotfix SLA (48h) as an optional paid item. If bought, include contractual acceptance window and courier expedited fee.

priya: Operational notes to surface to customer:
- signer key rotation requires re-signing of active bundles (we can re-sign if provided verification certs; if they require customer-side HSM signing, that's a PS engagement)
- delta bundles must include operator version pin in manifest for compatibility
- chain-of-custody: tamper-evident seals, serial-numbered media, signed courier manifest
- offline telemetry export (periodic encrypted upload) can be offered as an optional workflow

ops-bot: Created ticket POC-SL-2026 and added internal runbook. Assigned to ethan + priya.

carla: Thanks team. I'll draft the SecOps email with the short checklist + sample commands + pricing lines and ask them to select cadence. Will include option for emergency hotfix SLA and HSM/PS pricing. Closing thread once sent. :white_check_mark:
